boundary: Financial / Assets would be added if the exported file held full card numbers with security codes or other data usable to charge the cards, rather than masked references, expiry dates and billing addresses.
factor: disclosure of masked payment-card details that expose identity but cannot be used to spend
note: The assessor claimed the financial exposure is independent because the card data itself is the asset, but the card numbers are masked, so monetary loss is only a downstream consequence of the confidentiality breach.
